profileBehavior.unlock: World 2 existing completion rules, boss level 20. A pending unlock is persisted before world travel and recovered at launch even without a next level.
profileBehavior.selection: Swap the active identity with the chosen stable collection slot. Transfer each custom color; translate each unchanged native channel to the selected identity native palette.
profileBehavior.resident: Always render the stored slot occupant using that occupant own original palette and ground baseline.
profileBehavior.reset: Clear pending unlock and collection occupants, select main, translate unchanged native channels and retain custom choices.
profileBehavior.reveal: Desert reveal switches from old to new identity once at 0.68; both paintings are fully opaque, never a frozen crossfade.
